snippet.title: Chess Folk — Official Trailer | Your Offline Chess Club
snippet.description:
Welcome to Chess Folk—your own offline chess club, filled with memorable rivals, friendly competition, and a reason to play one more game.
📱 Play on Android:
Get Chess Folk on Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.space64.chessfolk
💻 Wishlist on Steam:
Visit Chess Folk on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/5221860/Chess_Folk/
Meet more than 300 fictional AI opponents with different personalities and playing styles. Enter offline tournaments, follow your rating progress, and find your next challenge across the board.
♟️ Meet patient defenders, bold attackers, and Susu the Panda
🏆 Compete in Swiss, round-robin, and knockout tournaments
📈 Track your personal rating and match history
📚 Explore guided chess lessons
🌍 Enjoy the core game offline
Stay after the trailer for bonus gameplay—and a little challenge from Susu.
“So… you play like a grandmaster? Let’s see.”
This video combines actual Chess Folk gameplay with AI-generated cinematic scenes and voiceover. The club cinematics are promotional illustrations.
Developed by Space64.
Your next move starts here.
#ChessFolk #Chess #IndieGame
